blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Iga Swiatek has withdrawn from the Ningbo Open a day before her scheduled round-of-16 match against Czech Marie Bouzkova on Wednesday. Swiatek pulled out of the WTA 500 event due to a left thigh injury that’s been an issue since the second round of the Wuhan Open. “After careful consideration, I’ve decided to withdraw from the tournament,” the second-seeded Swiatek said in a statement on Tuesday.
